title: Preparation of M9 Media
author: NUS iGEM
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8cjhsun

steps.title: Prepare Stock Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the following stock solutions using the specified reagents:

substeps.instruction: Prepare 5x M9 salt using M9 Minimal Salts 5X (Merck MilliporeSigma/Sigma-Aldrich Catalog #M9956).
Prepare 1M Calcium Chloride (CaCl2) using Fisher Scientific Catalog #BP510.
Prepare 1M Magnesium sulfate solution using G-Biosciences Catalog #786-530.

steps.title: Mix M9 Media Components
steps.instruction: Combine the following components in a vessel:

substeps.instruction: Add 200 mL M9 Minimal Salts 5X (Merck MilliporeSigma/Sigma-Aldrich Catalog #M9956).
Add 100 µL 1 M Calcium Chloride (CaCl2) (Fisher Scientific Catalog #BP510).
Add 2 mL 1 M Magnesium sulfate solution (G-Biosciences Catalog #786-530).

steps.title: Finalize Media Volume
steps.instruction: Top up the mixture with sterile deionized water to reach a final volume of 1 liter of M9 media.
